item.title: Silverburn (ex-Taint and Hark) share new video for ‘Bathe In Fire’ ahead of tour with Crowbar
item.description: SILVERBURN SHARE VIDEO FOR ‘BATHE IN FIRE’ AHEAD OF UK AND IRELAND TOUR WITH CROWBAR Silverburn release a new video for ‘Bathe In Fire’ along with a new vinyl edition of their ’Self Induced Transcendental Annihilation’ album. The band will hit the road with New Orleans sludge giants Crowbar in February, with this tour only turquoise LP edition and video to commemorate the journey. Silverburn have already blazed across the UK with the likes of Mutoid Man, High on Fire, Crowbar, Kylesa and Arctang

item.title: POISON THE WELL announce new album ‘Peace In Place’
item.description: POISON THE WELL announce new album ‘Peace In Place’, their first album in over fifteen years New single, ‘Thoroughbreds’, out now ‘Peace In Place’ is out March 20th Photo Credit: Sarai Kelley POISON THE WELL released the definitive album The Opposite of December… A Season of Separation in December 1999 and it went on to become a benchmark of the genre that has inspired a generation of bands. The album was chosen as one of the “15 ’90s Metalcore Albums That Still Resonate Today” by Brooklyn Vegan

item.title: Sins of Omission re-issue The Creation Out 3rd March via Hammerheart Records
item.description: Sins of Omission re-issue The CreationOut 3rd March via Hammerheart Records Swedish death metal maniacs Sins of Omission have announced the re-issue of their 1999 debut album The Creation via Hammerheart Records. This forgotten gem will be released for the first time on vinyl on 3rd March, 2026.
